subject: SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB829, PB1094. The PREFIXED length field is signed with SIGNED, the shorter field with SHORT; it supports GR18's table values exactly (65535 / 32767 / 4294967295 / 2147483647), which are 8.5.1.10.1's PREFIXED candidate for the item's maximum size (a 70000-character sender stores 65535 under SHORT PREFIXED and 32767 under SIGNED SHORT PREFIXED), and the field is in the record: data described with the structure is prefixed by it - four characters for PREFIXED and SIGNED PREFIXED, two for SHORT PREFIXED and SIGNED SHORT PREFIXED, most significant byte first (DOC-A.1-205), counting character positions (SHORT PREFIXED CDE -> 0 3 67 68 69; PREFIXED DELIMITED F -> 0 0 0 1 70 0; SIGNED PREFIXED GH -> 0 0 0 2 71 72; SIGNED SHORT PREFIXED L -> 0 1 76), read through a second description of the file. See D-DL3.
